root_goal: Raise and verify average observed useful-work span to at least 600 seconds per 15-minute turn through per-turn measurement, diagnosis, policy correction, and retest.

completed: Canonical schedule restored to a single hourly RRULE at minute :15 for the next live test.
Scheduler policy changed to fixed quarter rotation 00->15->30->45->00 instead of actual-wake+15.
Per-turn utilization optimization target set to rolling mean >=600 seconds with at least 3 valid completed turns.
Measure -> diagnose -> corrective experiment -> retest loop made durable policy.
checkpoint.observation: Prior runs lacked enough end-boundary telemetry and often stopped after short bursts. The active root now treats every 15-minute turn as a utilization experiment and forbids declaring success from one burst.
checkpoint.next_action: At the next expected :15 wake, rearm this same hourly RRULE to :30 first; then record utilization telemetry, plan a full 15-minute useful work packet, work continuously, and persist the completed-turn measurement/corrective experiment.
